result.summary: The page mostly renders correctly, but there is one clear data/rendering bug ('€NaN delivery') plus a few minor layout observations.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card in the 'Fastest near you' section shows '€NaN delivery', indicating a failed numeric calculation or missing delivery fee value.
issues.suggestion: Validate the delivery fee value before formatting; fall back to a placeholder like 'Free delivery' or hide the fee line when data is missing, and fix the upstream data source.

issues.description: The last category chip in the filter row (after 'Healthy') is cut off at the screen edge with no visible label, making it look like a broken empty pill.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal chip list shows a partially visible labeled chip or add a fade/scroll affordance so the cut-off element clearly reads as scrollable content.

issues.description: The third restaurant card ('Trattoria Piccol...') is truncated at the right edge, cutting both the image and the name text abruptly.
issues.suggestion: This is likely intentional carousel peeking, but consider adding ellipsis handling on the name and consistent peek width so the truncation looks deliberate.

issues.description: 'Green Bowl Poké' shows an unusual delivery fee of '€0.90' while another card shows '€0 delivery' with different formatting ('€0' vs '€0.90'), leading to inconsistent price formatting.
issues.suggestion: Standardize currency formatting across cards (e.g., always two decimals or use 'Free delivery' for €0).
